chain.title: Darkstone
chain.desc: Gather Darkstone for your workshop and the Hephaestus Forge foundation. Keep the polished and carved variants organised so the multiblock is easier to assemble correctly.

chain.title: Arcane Crystal
chain.desc: Mine Arcane Crystal Ore and reserve crystals for machines as well as dust. This resource branch supports both practical tools and the forge rituals.

chain.title: Edelwood
chain.desc: Cut from the twisted Edelwood trees that grow in dark biomes. Its planks make buckets, jars and the mod's early machinery.

chain.title: Obsidian With Iron
chain.desc: Obsidian ringed with Iron Nuggets. An intermediate block that exists purely to be smelted.

chain.title: Rune
chain.desc: Mined from Runic Stone, Runic Darkstone and Runic Deepslate, which generate as flecks through the underground. Runes carry the mod's enchant-like magic.

chain.title: Spawner Scrap
chain.desc: Recover Spawner Scrap from the acquisition route shown in your pack. Decide which spawners you can spare before breaking one that could support a useful farm.

chain.title: Ender Pearl Fragment
chain.desc: Endermen drop fragments alongside pearls through a loot modifier. Nine make a pearl, and they gate Corrupti Dust and the Draco Arcanus Staff.

chain.title: Dragon Scale
chain.desc: Obtain Dragon Scales through a supported dragon-related route. If using the Dragon Head recipe, prepare the Mystical Dagger first; do not assume that route is required when the pack also provides scales as loot.

chain.title: Find a Nipa
chain.desc: The mod's only registered structure, generated as a ground copy and as a floating island with a chest. It is the sole source of forbidden_arcanus:nipa, which has no recipe anywhere in the jar.

chain.title: Strike the First Ritual
chain.desc: Prepare a Blacksmith Gavel for activating forge rituals. Check the recipe's required forge tier, enhancers and essence supplies before striking the prepared forge.

chain.title: Light from Below
chain.desc: Search for Stellarite using the generation and acquisition information in the installed pack. Save a piece for the Eternal Stella ritual instead of spending the first supply elsewhere.

chain.title: Arcane Crystal Dust
chain.desc: Smelt or blast an Arcane Crystal, or run it through the Clibano. The mod's universal reagent: it is in the soap, the bottles, the dusts and the deorum.

chain.title: Clibano Core
chain.desc: Use the Clibano Core as the centre of the furnace multiblock shown by the mod. Finish the surrounding structure and test a supported smelting recipe before investing in its upgrades.

chain.title: Utrem Jar
chain.desc: Edelwood Planks around colourless glass. A jar that stores a single item type in bulk, and the vessel the Soul Extractor is built from.

chain.title: Obsidian Ingot
chain.desc: Smelt or blast Obsidian With Iron. The metal behind the Obsidian Skull, the Dark Nether Star and the Draco Arcanus line.

chain.title: Test Tube
chain.desc: Prepare Test Tubes for the blood-collection route. Read the item instructions before filling them; Blood is a separate forge resource from Souls, Aureal and experience.

chain.title: Lens of Veritatis
chain.desc: Use the Lens of Veritatis to inspect hidden details described by its tooltip. This utility branch uses your early Arcane Crystals and Spawner Scrap without needing the late forge rituals.

chain.title: Quantum Catcher
chain.desc: Test the Quantum Catcher on a suitable creature and release it in a prepared enclosure. Check the tool's restrictions before planning to move a dangerous or unusual mob.

chain.title: Dark Matter
chain.desc: Smelt an Edelwood Log. The log burns down to a lump of pure dark, used as the dagger's grip and in the higher rituals.

chain.title: A Place for Every Offering
chain.desc: Arrange Darkstone Pedestals around the Hephaestus Forge in the ritual layout. Place each required ingredient on its pedestal before starting the ritual.

chain.title: Soul Extractor
chain.desc: Use the Soul Extractor according to its tooltip and gather Souls for later forge rituals. Keep a storage area for the four different forge essences so one missing supply does not stop an otherwise prepared ritual.

chain.title: Mundabitur Dust
chain.desc: Prepare Mundabitur Dust for world transformations as well as crafting. Its most important early use is creating a Hephaestus Forge from a Smithing Table on the correct multiblock foundation.

chain.title: Sanity Meter
chain.desc: Keep the Sanity Meter available while investigating the mod's corruption mechanics. Read its current display rather than assuming every dark-looking block has the same effect.

chain.title: Corrupti Dust
chain.desc: Arcane Crystal Dust, an Ender Pearl Fragment, an Obsidian Ingot, Blaze Powder and Nether Wart. The corrupting agent that turns a Rune dark.

chain.title: Draco Arcanus Armour
chain.desc: Dragon Scale over Obsidian Ingots. The full set is the mod's endgame armour and the reason to farm scales.

chain.title: Obsidian Skull
chain.desc: Craft the Obsidian Skull and read its protection tooltip before equipping it. Test the effect in a controlled situation rather than assuming it makes every fire or lava hazard harmless.

chain.title: Dark Nether Star
chain.desc: A Nether Star wrapped in Obsidian Ingots. One Wither, one star, one scepter.

chain.title: Draco Arcanus Staff
chain.desc: Ender Pearl Fragments, an Obsidian Ingot and an Ender Pearl. It throws a homing arcane bolt and is the base of the scepter.

chain.title: One of Four Essences
chain.desc: Prepare Aureal Bottles and use the forge's appropriate input slot to add Aureal. Check all four essence bars before a ritual rather than filling only the one this bottle supplies.

chain.title: Deorum
chain.desc: Gold, Charcoal, Arcane Crystal Dust and Mundabitur Dust. Deorum is the mod's magical gold and the material of its lanterns, glass and arcane darkstone.

chain.title: Dark Rune
chain.desc: A Rune shaken with Corrupti Dust. Darker magic than the plain rune, and the blade component of the Mystical Dagger.

chain.title: Draco Arcanus Scepter
chain.desc: Upgrade the Draco Arcanus Staff with the Dark Nether Star and the remaining ingredients. Try the upgraded attacks in open space before taking the weapon into a crowded base.

chain.title: Mystical Dagger
chain.desc: Dark Matter, a Dark Rune, Deorum and an Edelwood Stick. It is not really a weapon: its job is to carve scales off a Dragon Head.

chain.title: Spectral Eye Amulet
chain.desc: Finish the Spectral Eye Amulet and inspect the information it reveals while equipped. It is a late utility project that can develop alongside the forge and armour branches.

chain.title: Raise the Hephaestus Forge
chain.desc: Build the forge foundation from the mod's diagram, place a Smithing Table in the centre and sneak-use Mundabitur Dust on it. The transformation creates the forge in the world; if this item objective needs detection, carefully collect and replace the finished forge.
chain.acquisition: Sneak-use Mundabitur Dust on the Smithing Table in the valid forge foundation. The resulting Hephaestus Forge has a self-drop loot table, allowing it to be collected and replaced.

chain.title: An Awakened Forge
chain.desc: Perform the forge-upgrade rituals in order until the Hephaestus Forge displays Tier 3. Supply their listed essences and pedestal ingredients, then confirm this checkpoint after checking the forge tier.

chain.title: A Lasting Tool
chain.desc: Raise the Hephaestus Forge to Tier 3, then prepare the Eternal Stella ritual with Stellarite, Xpetrified Orbs, a Diamond and the required essences. Finish the ritual before applying the Stella through its supported equipment recipe.

chain.title: Xpetrified Experience
chain.desc: Collect Xpetrified Orbs for forge rituals. In Forbidden Arcanus 2.6.1, a Black Hole absorbs experience orbs and ejects an Xpetrified Orb after gathering 60 XP; older releases may provide a different acquisition route.
chain.acquisition: Forbidden Arcanus 2.6.1 BlackHoleBlockEntity.serverTick absorbs ExperienceOrb entities, creates an XPETRIFIED_ORB ItemStack at 60 stored XP, and throws that stack into the world.

notes: Reviewed against the primary sources listed above. Every chain row now declares its intended prerequisites; an empty list is an intentional independent starting point. The order is topological. Item and checkpoint-icon asset paths and typed objective identifiers were checked against the listed jar or source snapshot. Jar inspection verifies identifiers and selected mechanics, not that every route has been completed in game. Corrected an earlier false exclusion: the Hephaestus Forge is created by Mundabitur Dust world interaction and has an inventory self-drop. Its Tier 3 Eternal Stella ritual is present in this jar.

coverage.scope: Resource branches, utility tools, actual world-created Hephaestus Forge, tier upgrades and Eternal Stella.
coverage.limits: A curated teaching route, not every item or mechanic. Recipe quantities and conditions follow the installed pack. Manual checkpoints require player confirmation. No complete in-game playthrough claimed.
